Star-field taxonomy + action tokens: the region groups the
Sourcesrc/core\tokens\starfield\kinds.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

LOCAL_GROUP

Local Group dwarf + satellite galaxies — the ~30 small companions orbiting the Milky Way and Andromeda (SagDEG, LMC/SMC, the faint spheroidals, and the M31 subgroup).

HIERARCHY

Cosmic-hierarchy boundary structures — Interstellar Neighborhood, Local Group volume, superclusters, and the observable-universe rim.

SF_KINDS

Body kinds — drive the dossier badge label and the material recipe in the scene builder (textured sphere vs emissive star vs sprite nebula).

CLUSTER

Star clusters (open/globular) — sprite recipe shared with nebulae.

DWARF_GALAXY

Dwarf spheroidal/irregular galaxies — seeded elliptical point clouds (unresolved smudges, no photographic disc to fake).

STRUCTURE

Cosmic-hierarchy boundary shells + speckle volumes.

BELT

Small-body annulus (asteroid belt, Kuiper belt) — a seeded Points disc between belt.inner/belt.outer; not raycast-pickable, the navigator still flies to it for the dossier.

SATELLITE

Artificial companion (ISS-class orbiters) — registered only inside a host body's satellites list; gives the dossier badge a real label instead of falling through to the raw kind string.

COMET

Icy small body on an eccentric orbit (Halley-class) — renders a dark irregular nucleus wrapped in a sublimated coma with ion and dust tails that stream anti-sunward and grow toward periapsis.

ASTEROID

Airless small body — main-belt asteroids, NEOs and Kuiper-belt objects (Vesta, Bennu, Ryugu, Arrokoth). Renders a crumpled irregular rock with the cratered procedural surface; distinct from DWARF (hydrostatic-ish bodies like Ceres/Pluto/Eris).

SF_SURFACES

Surface-recipe hints — catalog defs may pin the procedural painter's style so a body matches its dossier description (a tidally-locked lava planet must never draw ocean bands). Absent → the seed picks within the kind's bias as before.

ROCK

Cratered regolith — moons, asteroids, scorched inner worlds.

ICE

Bright fractured ice — Europa/Enceladus/KBO streaked surfaces.

GAS

Banded atmosphere — gas/ice giants and mini-Neptunes.

LAVA

Dark crust split by glowing fault veins — lava worlds.

OCEAN

Deep water with island mottle + polar caps — ocean worlds.

SF_ACTIONS

Toolbar/panel action names dispatched through data-action clicks.
